scenarios.name: Widget catalog lifecycle
scenarios.description: Create a widget through the public API, read it back, then delete it (v1) — a cross-endpoint business path over the widget resource.

assumptions.statement: A widget created via POST /v1/widgets is immediately readable via GET /v1/widgets/{widgetId} with the id returned by the create response.
The widget id placeholder {{widget_id}} is resolved by the executor at runtime from the create step response.
